tags.reason: Published only on the private incubation repository, which was deleted after the public consolidation onto Generous-Corp/vellum. The tag object, release, attestation, and assets no longer exist. Re-creating the name would give a second immutable v0.1.7 with different bytes, so the name is never reused. The target commit remains in this repository's history.

Tagged by the owner key on the merge of #92, the first org release after v0.1.7's retirement (D5), but never published: like v0.1.9 it tagged the commit that landed its release request, which can never satisfy the reconciled observatory tail check, and every input to a re-run is fixed by the tag. Its mirror also carried only 2 of the 13 promotion units, so the owner made v0.1.9 the promotion coordinate on 2026-10-27. The tag stays in place under protect-release-tags; no release is published from it, and the name is never reused.

Tagged and frozen by release-tag.yml on the commit that landed the v0.1.9 release request (#137's merge), but never published: its provenance run (41368275724) failed the reconciled observatory tail check, because a commit that lands a release request can never name itself as the observatory cursor, and every input to a re-run is fixed by the frozen tag. The tag stays in place and frozen; no release is published from it, and the name is never reused. v0.1.10 is the next release: the combined Phase 4 + M1 release from the m158 re-export, tagged on an observatory-reconciled commit (owner decisions 2026-11-02).
